blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Most parts of the country may experience generally fair weather on Friday, Nov. 27, the state weather bureau reported. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Obet Badrina said during a 5 a.m. weather advisory that large parts of the country may see fair weather with a chance of localized thunderstorms by the afternoon until evening.
